head: TikTok Shop gets its own app in four Asian countries
dek: TikTok quietly launched a separate TikTok Shop app in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines, on iPhone and Android, with shopping through live streams and short videos.
details: It offers personal product picks, app-only deals, in-app checkout, order tracking and customer support. It was first spotted by social media consultant Matt Navarra.
where: Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines; iPhone and Android
means: If you shop on TikTok in those countries, you can now do it without the video app.
todo: Nothing to do elsewhere; TikTok hasn't said if it's coming to more countries.
thumb_words: TIKTOK SHOP GETS ITS OWN APP
